patch_list: Block ads

Stops all bundled ad SDKs from initialising or loading ads (AppLovin MAX, AdMob, Meta, Prebid, BidMachine, Smaato, InMobi, Fyber, Unity, Pangle, BIGO, Vungle, Moloco, Amazon, Nimbus) and removes the empty banner space. Premium is not unloc…
Block cleartext traffic
Disallows unencrypted HTTP connections app-wide (the stock app allows them everywhere).
Block identity trackers
Disables LiveRamp ATS (hashed-email identity graph) and the HUMAN/WhiteOps device-fingerprinting SDK.
Bypass VPN detection
Always reports that no VPN is active to the ad SDK that checks for one.
Disable analytics
Disables AppsFlyer, Yandex AppMetrica, Firebase Analytics, iFunny's own event uploads and the upload of ad/attribution IDs to iFunny's servers.
Disable crash reporters
Disables Firebase Crashlytics and Firebase Sessions telemetry.
Disable location
Removes the location permissions and stops iFunny's background location upload. The in-app map will no longer work.
Hide Premium upsells
Hides the "Hide ads" tab and badge, the Boost post button and the Premium / Trial / limited-time-offer entries in the toolbar and side menu. Does not unlock Premium.
Hide promo cards
Removes Premium trial promo cards, surveys, "ask to smile" prompts and the inline push-notification request from the feed. Content cards are kept.
Limit ad tracking
Removes advertising-ID, Privacy Sandbox, Google Services ID, account-list and vendor app-info permissions, denies analytics/ad consent by default and removes root-app detection queries.
Material You theme
Recolors iFunny with your wallpaper-based Material You (dynamic) colors on Android 12+, and fixes low-contrast date / view-count text.
Strip photo location
Removes GPS and camera serial/owner EXIF tags from JPEG, PNG and WebP images before upload. A cache copy is uploaded; the original photo is never modified.
